/* The mono face, self-hosted, generated by `python3 scripts/build_fonts.py
   traffic` and kept here as ONE copy — the contract engine/shared/goatcounter.txt
   and engine/shared/theme-boot.txt already use: every generated page's builder
   reads this file, and traffic.html takes it as an ENGINE fence, so all seven
   surfaces carry the same bytes.

   It is separate from fonts/barlow-fontface.css on purpose. That file is read
   by build_landing_page, build_coverage_map and build_county_pages besides,
   about 190 pages that paint no mono at all, and a face declared where nothing
   asks for it is the state build_brand_tokens.py's own mono check exists to
   catch from the other side.

   400 ONLY. Every surface carrying this block paints one mono weight, measured
   in a browser. The sources pages need 500 as well, for their matrix column
   headers, and keep their own subset block rather than widening this one.

   `url(fonts/...)` resolves against the directory beside the page: the repo
   root's for privacy.html, about.html and traffic.html, and each instance's
   own for its history page. Every one of those directories already carries
   these two files. */
@font-face {
  font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono';
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url(fonts/ibm-plex-mono-400-latin-ext.woff2) format('woff2');
  unicode-range: U+0100-02BA, U+02BD-02C5, U+02C7-02CC, U+02CE-02D7, U+02DD-02FF, U+0304, U+0308, U+0329, U+1D00-1DBF, U+1E00-1E9F, U+1EF2-1EFF, U+2020, U+20A0-20AB, U+20AD-20C0, U+2113, U+2C60-2C7F, U+A720-A7FF;
}
@font-face {
  font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono';
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-display: swap;
  src: url(fonts/ibm-plex-mono-400-latin.woff2) format('woff2');
  unicode-range: U+0000-00FF, U+0131, U+0152-0153, U+02BB-02BC, U+02C6, U+02DA, U+02DC, U+0304, U+0308, U+0329, U+2000-206F, U+20AC, U+2122, U+2191, U+2193, U+2212, U+2215, U+FEFF, U+FFFD;
}
